title: Web Designer for Custom Website
description:
Upwork Job Post: WordPress/Elementor – Multilingual Landmark Info Website (MVP)


Project Description:
We're building a multilingual WordPress website for associations/institutions that gives tourists free information about landmarks via QR code (text + audio) or directly through the landing page of that association/institution. Visitors scan a QR code on-site, land on a subpage for a specific section of the landmark (e.g. Picture next to the main entry of the building), select their language via flag icons, read/listen to the explanation, and can optionally leave a rating/comment which is not visible for other website viewer.
There should be one single subpage per association/institution with a predefined template for each and every interesting element (like picture next to the main entry). 


Current status: 
hosting is live, WordPress is installed, HTTPS is set up, and the following plugins are already installed and activated: Elementor Pro, Polylang, Site Reviews, Pretty Links, UpdraftPlus, Code Snippets. All 7 languages are already set up in Polylang (DE, EN, TR, AL, MK, BS, MS). A first attempt at the header (flag language switcher) exists but is not finished/live yet.


Important: 
I have no web design experience. After this project, I only want to add content myself (text, photos, audio files) via Elementor — the structure/templates need to be fully finished and functional.


One Landing Page:
- Placeholder for some content
- Switch the language with Polylang
- Whenever one new sight-seeing is published it should be visible as a preview in the landing page (last 3 new sightseeings).
- Possibity to search: First country (just the one where minimum one sight seeing already exists (e.g. Germany). Then just the cities where we have already minium sight seeing (e.g. Hamburg), then all names of the sightseeing to open the subpage of that sightseeing.
These three information are visible in the linktree of the website: e.g. www.abc.com/germany/hamburg/harbour


Scope of Work

1. Header (global, via Elementor Theme Builder)
Flag-based language switcher (Polylang), top left or right, working for all 7 languages (more langues might follow later)
Below/next to it, a breadcrumb line: Country / City / Institute
Clean, simple design (not a generic demo layout)

2. Page template for one "Section" (as a reusable Elementor template)
Each subpage (= one sightseeing) needs:
Subpage header (e.g. "harbour")

Title: Entry to main building
Photo carousel (1–3 images with captions)
Audio player (for an uploaded MP3 file)
Text block for reading along
Star rating + comment field including optional image upload (plugin: Site Reviews) – comments/images should NOT be published publicly, only sent to a contact email address (configurable per landmark)
The template must be easy to duplicate, so I can swap out text/image/audio per language/section without rebuilding the layout

3. Link/QR preparation to jump directly to that part of the subpage.
Set up 10 Pretty Links pointing to the (placeholder-content) subpages, plus a short explanation of how I can create additional links myself

4. Handover
A short video guide (English) explaining how I, as a beginner, can:
create a new section page from the template
add text per language
swap out photos/audio
create a new Pretty Link


Technical Environment:
Hosting: All-Inkl
WordPress + Elementor Pro (Theme: Hello Elementor)
Multilingual: Polylang (already configured with 7 languages)
Ratings/comments: Site Reviews plugin (not published - just in backend)
Links: Pretty Links
Access credentials (wp-admin) will be provided after hiring


Not Needed:
No translation work (I'll handle this myself)
No audio recording (I'll handle this myself)
No automation/custom development beyond what's needed (this is an MVP)


MVP
MVP with one example you can decide to show me the results.


Timeline
Completion within 2 weeks preferred.


Application

Please briefly address the following in your proposal:

Experience with the Elementor Pro Theme Builder
Experience with Polylang (multilingual setup)
Experience with Site Reviews or similar rating/comment plugins with image upload
Estimated time and fixed-price quote
coverLetter:
Hi! Your QR-code landmark MVP is a brilliant concept, and I can build this exact setup using Elementor Pro and Polylang within your 2-week timeline for a fixed price of $650.

I specialize in the Elementor Pro Theme Builder and multilingual configurations. I will set up your Polylang flag switcher in the header, build the reusable "Section" template (integrating the audio player, image carousel, and breadcrumbs), and configure Site Reviews to route ratings privately to your admin email instead of displaying them publicly. I have built similar highly structured, easy-to-manage sites, such as https://www.seeintl.org/.

Once the structure is ready, I’ll record a step-by-step video guide showing you how to easily duplicate the template, swap content, and generate new Pretty Links.

Are you free for a quick chat to discuss the private email routing for the reviews?

title: Dynamic Landing Page Development for Client Sign-Up
description: We are seeking a skilled web developer to redesign the current website (browdoc.com) into a dynamic landing page.  The landing page MAIN PURPOSE is to sign up interested clients so that we can communicate, engage and begin a relationship with them through the EZ Text app. A QR code will bring them to the landing page, and on the landing page they will be asked to sign up to receive text alerts of when my mobile service will be in their area.  They will be given geographic areas to sign up under that is closest to them.  So this landing page's main purpose is to collect clients information to begin text alerting them of my mobile business route schedule in their area, as well as sending them promotion specials.  The page will need to collect essential information such as address area location and phone number. Additionally, this landing page will broadcast a calendar of my route stop schedule day to day, week to week.  It will also display my list of services and prices, see a client gallery portfolio, and frequent asked questions as well as an AI chatbox with prewritten answers. The ideal designer should have a strong portfolio of interactive landing pages and experience in user experience design. If you can create an engaging and user-friendly interface that drives sign-ups, we want to hear from you!

coverLetter:
